name: Break Apart destroys a target non-regalia item
notes: Break Apart's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Forest Cake (a plain ITEM, not REGALIA) is seeded onto the opponent's field as the target, avoiding the 'costs 2 more if it targets a regalia' branch (which isn't exercised here). Unlike the WEAPON targets destroyed in meltdown-level2-destroy-item/anathemas-end-load-gun's setup props, this plain ITEM resolves to its owner's graveyard, not their banish zone.
